text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management. First, make a clear plan and break big tasks into smaller steps. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent and important work first. If you have too much to do, think about scope management. Ask yourself what is truly necessary and what can be reduced or delayed. Finally, communication matters. Tell your teacher, boss, or team early if a deadline is at risk. Do not wait until the last minute. When you plan carefully, choose your tasks wisely, control the size of the work, and keep others informed, you can meet deadlines with less stress.
